_about: C-232 (the user, 2026-10-28, by multiple choice): THE SUBTLE LAYER's cards -- twenty-two, our own arcana, each with two faces on the book's purple: REASON (a circuit board under a green gradient; a daemon of the mainland, where the game teaches computer science and machine learning) and INSTINCT (a living net of nodes under gold; a daemon of the seven islands, where it teaches the mind). A keyword at the top, a phrase under the daemon. Drawn upright only; now and then shiny. A card is a prompt for noticing, never a prediction (4.33). Every word DRAFT -- the user reviews them on a sheet.
